Markus,

Short answer: Redwood operates as a processor for hosted API customers by default; customers are controllers for their end-users. We accept controller-initiated deletion requests under our DPA. For this case we should: 

- Confirm controller instruction in writing (DPO email is sufficient).
- Provide an export of processing activity related to the identifier (we can provide metadata, request logs, and a statement of deletion actions).
- Document backup deletion windows — we perform logical deletion immediately and physical purge per our retention schedule (standard is 30 days for backups unless contractually adjusted).

Evidence we can provide: exported logs (CSV), signed statement from Legal confirming role and deletion action, and a copy of the relevant DPA/SCC reference. I will prepare a short legal confirmation memo. Priyom, can security pull the relevant audit-logs export for john.doe@example.com and confirm timestamps?

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
